page: JSX syntax for HTML generation in Hono, used primarily server-side. Configuration: tsconfig.json with jsx: react-jsx, jsxImportSource: hono/jsx. Alternatively pragma directives or deno.json for Deno. File extension must be .tsx. Core types: FC for functional components, PropsWithChildren. Fragment (<></>) for grouping elements. Component composition with nested layouts. Features: metadata hoisting, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, memo for memoization, createContext/useContext for data sharing, async components, Suspense (experimental) with fallback, ErrorBoundary (experimental) for error catching, StreamingContext (experimental) for CSP nonce values. Integration with html middleware and jsx-renderer middleware. Custom type definitions via module augmentation. Questions: How do I set up JSX in Hono? Can I use async/await in components? How do I hoist metadata to head? What are fragments? How do I share data with context? How do I handle errors in components?

sections.manifest: tsconfig.json configuration: jsx: "react-jsx", jsxImportSource: "hono/jsx". Pragma directives alternative: @jsx jsx, @jsxImportSource hono/jsx. Deno requires deno.json with jsx: "precompile", jsxImportSource: "@hono/hono/jsx". File extension requirement: .tsx not .ts. package.json scripts must reference .tsx files. Questions: What's the tsconfig syntax? How do I configure Deno? Why must files be .tsx?

Basic JSX usage with Hono. Import Hono, FC type from hono/jsx. Define components as FC functional components. Props typing: FC<{ prop: type }>. Layout component pattern with props.children. Component composition with nested layout. Handler uses c.html(<Component props={values} />). File example: index.tsx structure. Questions: What's the component syntax? How do I type props? How do I nest components? What's the FC type?

Metadata hoisting automatically moves document metadata (<title>, <link>, <meta>) to <head>. Enabled via c.setRenderer() in middleware. Pattern: middleware sets renderer to wrap content in html structure, route handler uses c.render() with metadata and content. Automatic hoisting happens regardless of depth. Behavior note: existing head elements not removed, new elements appended (duplicates possible). Useful for components defining page metadata far from <head>. Questions: How do I hoist metadata? What tags are hoisted? What happens with duplicate titles? How do I set up the renderer?

Fragment component groups multiple elements without extra DOM node. Import Fragment from hono/jsx. Syntax: <Fragment>...</Fragment> or shorthand <>...</>. Use case: return multiple sibling elements cleanly. Requires proper setup for <></> shorthand. Questions: What is a fragment? When do I use fragments? What's the difference between <Fragment> and <>?

PropsWithChildren type for components accepting children. Import PropsWithChildren from hono/jsx. Type definition: function Component({ title, children }: PropsWithChildren<Post>). Correctly infers child element types. Combines explicit props with children parameter. Questions: How do I type component children? What's PropsWithChildren? How do I combine props and children?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML inserts raw HTML directly. Syntax: dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: 'HTML content' }}. Use case: inject pre-rendered HTML, markdown, user content. Caveat: XSS security risk if content untrusted. Questions: How do I insert raw HTML? What's the syntax? When should I use dangerouslySetInnerHTML?

memo() memoizes computed component strings for optimization. Import memo from hono/jsx. Pattern: const Header = memo(() => <header>...</header>). Reduces re-computation on re-renders. Use case: expensive header/footer components. Example: Layout wrapping memoized Header/Footer. Questions: How do I memoize components? When should I use memo? Does memo improve performance?

createContext and useContext for global data sharing without prop drilling. Import createContext, useContext from hono/jsx. Pattern: ThemeContext = createContext(defaultValue). Usage: const theme = useContext(ThemeContext). Provider wrapping: <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>. Example: theme provider with light/dark modes. Works with component tree. Questions: How do I use context? How do I create a context? What's the Provider pattern? When do I use context over props?

Async components with async/await support. Function marked async returns JSX. c.html() automatically awaits async components. Use case: data fetching, database queries inside component. Example: async function with setTimeout, await. Benefits: clean async data loading in render tree. Questions: Can components be async? How do I fetch data in components? Does c.html() handle async automatically?

Suspense (experimental) for async component streaming. Import from hono/jsx/streaming. Used with renderToReadableStream(). Wraps async components: loading...}>. Fallback renders first, awaits content displays after Promise resolves. Requires specific response headers: Content-Type: text/html, Transfer-Encoding: chunked. Questions: How do I use Suspense? What's the fallback? How do I set up streaming?

ErrorBoundary (experimental) catches component errors. Syntax: Error UI}>. Works with sync and async components. Combines with Suspense: wrap async + Suspense in ErrorBoundary. Shows fallback on error. Prevents component crash from propagating. Questions: How do I catch component errors? What does ErrorBoundary do? Can I use it with async components?

StreamingContext (experimental) provides configuration for streaming components. Import from hono/jsx/streaming. Provides scriptNonce value for CSP compliance. Pattern: <StreamingContext value={{ scriptNonce: 'nonce-value' }}>. Automatically adds nonce to <script> tags in Suspense/ErrorBoundary. Useful for Content Security Policy headers. Response header: Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'nonce-<value>'. Questions: How do I use StreamingContext? What's scriptNonce? How do I add CSP nonce to scripts?

Integration with html middleware for templating. Import html from hono/html. Combine JSX components with html tagged templates. Pattern: Layout as html template, Content as JSX component, Layout receives children. Props interface for type safety. Render: c.html(<Content />). Both JSX and html work together seamlessly. Reference: /docs/helpers/html for details. Questions: How do I use html middleware with JSX? What's the layout pattern? How do I type data?

JSX Renderer Middleware simplifies HTML page creation. Reference: /docs/middleware/builtin/jsx-renderer. Provides convenient helpers for rendering pages with JSX. Questions: What's the JSX Renderer Middleware? How do I use it?

Custom type definitions extend JSX IntrinsicElements. declare module hono/jsx, JSX namespace. IntrinsicElements interface adds custom elements and attributes. Example: 'my-custom-element' with x-event attribute. Syntax: interface IntrinsicElements { 'tag-name': HTMLAttributes & { customAttr: type } }. Enables TypeScript support for custom elements. Questions: How do I add custom JSX elements? How do I type custom attributes? What's the module augmentation syntax?
